title: Burkhard Balz: 40 years of the Deutsche Bundesbank's Representative Office in New York
body:
Speech by Mr Burkhard Balz, Member of the Executive Board of the Deutsche Bundesbank, at the reception marking 40 years of the Representative Office of the Deutsche Bundesbank in the United States, New York City, 7 July 2026.

Source URL: https://www.bis.org/review/r260813f.htm

title: Denis Beau: Opportunities and risks for CCPs and their overseers in a changing environment
body:
Keynote speech by Mr Denis Beau, First Deputy Governor of the Bank of France, at the CCP Global Annual Meeting 2026, Amsterdam, 23 June 2026.

Source URL: https://www.bis.org/review/r260813e.htm

title: Joachim Nagel: Acting together for a sovereign and competitive Europe
body:
Speech by Dr Joachim Nagel, President of the Deutsche Bundesbank, at the meeting with the European ambassadors' delegation on the occasion of Ireland's Presidency of the Council of the European Union, Frankfurt am Main, 21 July 2026.

Source URL: https://www.bis.org/review/r260805f.htm
